Every quoted sentence below was checked, by script, to appear word for word in the page text read at the revision named. Where a page quotes the game's own text (dossier tips, upgrade names and descriptions, codex lines), the note states the fact in its own words and does not copy it.

lines.line: Summary: A flying demon with a jetpack. Once it has locked on, it fires volleys of homing missiles from its rocket launchers. Its claw swipe is the only other attack, and it hits much less hard.

quoted: The revenant is able to shoot a barrage of guided missiles at the player if it is able to lock on, and retains its flight capabilities
leaving it with only its much weaker claw swipe
The Doom Slayer stabs the revenant's jetpack

lines.line: Looks like: Glowing green eyes, cybernetic parts around the head and neck, and rocket launchers detailed so that they look like mouths.

quoted: its eyeballs now glow green, it lacks blood on its forehead, new cybernetics are present on its head and neck, its mouth shape is a bit different, and its metal parts are now cleaner in appearance, with new detailing on the rocket launchers that makes them resemble demonic mouths.

lines.line: Tips: It will dash out of the way of your shots too.

quoted: Dashing or double-jumping will break its lock-on.
It can also dash to evade incoming fire.

lines.line: Summary: A large, slow heavy demon with 3,500 health, or 490 while staggered. Its arm cannons throw fireballs from a distance. Up close it switches to two flamethrowers and a blast that leaves harmful energy lingering on the floor.

quoted: Mancubi are big and slow.
the ability to use dual flamethrowers at short range in addition to its usual fireball launchers.
Its close range area-of-effect attack has been changed to leave an area of damaging energy on the ground
Class:Heavy
Health: 3 500 and 490 (when demon is stagger)

lines.line: Weak points: Break its arm cannons and its attacks do far less damage, and the flamethrowers stop working altogether. A chainsaw or glory kill to the chest blows it up: big demons nearby take damage and stagger, and small ones can die.

quoted: the mancubus' arm cannons can be damaged, making the attacks from the aforementioned cannons significantly weaker and disabling the flamethrower function entirely.
It is best to perform a glory kill or chainsaw on the mancubus' chest as this will cause the mancubus to explode and damage and falter large demons or even kill smaller demons within the vicinity.

lines.line: Looks like: Two small greenish eyes, armour plating on its body, and a bare, glowing yellow organ that looks like a heart sitting in its chest.

quoted: It now has two smaller, greenish eyes, and a yellow exposed heart-like organ in its chest.
The Doom Slayer is able to spear the glowing heart-like organ in the mancubus' chest
The armor plating that has replaced their original carapaces

lines.line: Tips: Stay at range and use heavy weapons, because its flamethrowers and ground blast hurt a lot up close. The rocket launcher suits it since it is too slow to dodge rockets, and the ballista's speed and damage take cannons off from far away. The heavy cannon's precision bolt scope can snipe cannons from across the arena, but check behind you while scoped. Do not let it pin you in a corner: it is big, and it hits hard at close range.

quoted: Your best strategy is to use heavy-hitting weapons at range, because when you are closer, the mancubus can use its flamethrowers and AOE to deal you large amounts of damage.
the rocket launcher (they cannot dodge the rockets as they are too slow)
the ballista (its high damage potential and projectile velocity make it an good weapon for removing their cannons at long range)
with a special spot saved for the heavy cannon's precision bolt.
make sure no enemies sneak up on you while you are scoped in.
Avoid letting mancubi corner you

lines.line: Summary: An armoured demon whose main attack is a charge. It has 1,000 health, but takes bonus damage from hits on its tail and from the blood punch.

quoted: The pinky actually has 1000 HP, but increased damage is dealt to the tail, or by the blood punch.
The pinky's main attack is to charge at the player

lines.line: Weak points: Its tail is completely unarmoured, so hits there do the most damage. A direct blood punch kills it on the spot, whichever side it lands on.

quoted: the front of the pinky is heavily armored but its tail has no armor at all, so the player should attack the pinky's tail to inflict the most damage.
A direct blood punch will instantly kill it, even from the front.

lines.line: Tips: Double-jump or dash to avoid the charge, and lure it into a wall: it gets stunned long enough for you to hit the tail. Freezing it with an ice bomb keeps it from turning. Sustained fire wears down its front armour, and the very strongest weapons (the ballista's destroyer blade mod, for one) go straight through it.

quoted: The pinky's main attack is to charge at the player, which the player can avoid by double-jumping or dashing.
The player should try to trick the pinky into charging into walls, which will stun it long enough for the player to attack its tail.
The pinky can also be frozen with an ice bomb to stop it turning round.
persistent attacks can eventually pierce it, and the strongest weapons, such as the ballista's destroyer blade mod, can bypass it entirely.

lines.line: Summary: A fast, aggressive demon that wields two flaming blades. It can survive a single direct BFG hit.

quoted: now equipped with a pair of flaming blades
it is able to survive a direct shot from the BFG.
the baron is faster and more aggressive than before.

lines.line: Looks like: Grey-brown skin the colour of ash, burning eyes, flesh glowing under the skin like hot coals, and magma in place of blood. It wields two flaming blades, and its shots are orange and red.

quoted: the baron of Hell now has an ashy grey-brown complexion with fiery eyes, inner flesh that glows like embers, and magma for blood.
now equipped with a pair of flaming blades
have been replaced by fiery orange and red ones.

lines.line: Tips: Keep your distance, just beyond the reach of its leap, and hot-swap among your heaviest weapons; the ballista, rocket launcher and super shotgun all work. A blood punch knocks it back and makes it easier to stun. Keeping the chaingun firing can hold off its attacks.

quoted: The Slayer's best strategy is to keep their distance, staying just slightly out of its jumping range, and hot-swap between their heaviest ordinance (the ballista, the rocket launcher, and the super shotgun work well).
The Doom Slayer can knock it back with a blood punch, making it more susceptible to stunning.
continuous use of the chaingun can stall its attacks.

lines.line: Summary: A Hell knight rebuilt with cybernetics and an energy blade on each arm. The blades give it more reach up close and let it fling a wave of energy at range. It has more health than a Hell knight, but the same ways of beating a Hell knight all work on it as well.

quoted: It is a cybernetic version of the Hell knight, with two energy blades attached to its arms.
The dread knight's arm blades give it a longer melee range than the Hell knight; it can also use the blades to throw an energy wave when the Doom Slayer is at a distance
Although the dread knight has higher health than its Hell knight cousin, it remains vulnerable to all of the techniques that are effective against the Hell knight.

lines.line: Tips: Watch for it crossing its arms: that is the start of the energy wave, so you can dodge it. When it leaps and slams down, it leaves harmful energy spread around itself, so keep clear. The rocket launcher's lock-on burst staggers it with a single use. The ballista and super shotgun make it flinch, and if you swap between all three it never gets a turn to attack.

quoted: the start-up animation is very obvious (it will cross its arms in front of itself)
When the dread knight performs a leaping slam, it releases a field of harmful energy around it to deter players from getting close while it is vulnerable.

One lock-on burst from the rocket launcher will stagger it, and the ballista and the super shotgun will flinch it. Hot-swapping between these weapons will prevent it from being able to attack you at all.

lines.line: Summary: A sneaky purple demon with 1,000 health, or 250 while staggered. It teleports next to or behind you, then pounces with a quick melee attack that does heavy damage.

quoted: The prowler employs a stealthy approach, teleporting behind or beside the player before leaping forward for a melee attack, which deals considerable damage and is performed rapidly
it has a fairly large amount of health, with 1000 HP (250 staggered).

lines.line: Weak points: One direct ballista hit staggers it at once, and a super shotgun blast from point-blank range kills it outright. An ice bomb pins it in place so it cannot teleport away.

quoted: the ballista will stagger the prowler instantly on a direct hit, and the super shotgun will kill it instantly at point-blank range.
Ice bombs should be used to keep it locked in place, preventing it from teleporting away.

lines.line: Looks like: A humanoid demon built like an imp but bigger, with long claws, purple skin and bony plates sticking out of its back. Its face has three eyes clustered together in the middle, and its jaw is in three sections.

quoted: a humanoid demon of similar stature to the imp, but is larger with purple skin, long claws, and a number of bony plates projecting from its back.
it has a spider-like cluster of three eyes in the center of its face. It has a tripartite jaw

lines.line: Tips: It is most dangerous when other demons are around, since they keep you busy and you may not notice it before it strikes. If it feels threatened it teleports away and sets up another ambush. From a distance, it may fire quick purple bolts of energy while it runs at you.

quoted: makes it especially dangerous if it appears among a group of other monsters, as they may keep the player distracted and unable to notice the prowler's presence until it is ready to strike.
if it perceives itself to be in danger, it will teleport to safety and try to set up another surprise attack.
It may also fire fast purple energy blasts as it charges if there is enough distance between it and the player.

lines.line: Summary: A cyborg demon with 1,200 health, or 240 while staggered, so it is fairly fragile. It fires ring-shaped lasers, sends shockwaves running along the floor from its arm blaster, and raises a force field wall that shields itself or other demons.

quoted: The carcass can fire ring-shaped lasers from the concave dish on its waist, create shockwaves along the ground with its arm blaster or create a wall-like force field to protect itself or other monsters
the carcass is relatively fragile, with 1200 HP (240 staggered)

lines.line: Weak points: Its force field is highly resistant to explosives, but a plasma rifle shot or a blood punch breaks it easily. A shot to the circle marked on the tank at its back kills it instantly.

quoted: The force field is heavily resistant to explosives, but like that of the shield soldiers, it is easily destroyed by the plasma rifle or a blood punch.
You can instantly kill a carcass by shooting the circle on the tank on its back.

lines.line: Looks like: A robot body with three insect-like legs carries the upper half of a zombie human. Its right arm carries a built-in blaster, and a dish sits at its waist.

quoted: It appears to be the upper torso of a zombified human fused with a robotic chassis with three insectile-like legs and a blaster fused into its right arm.
the concave dish on its waist

lines.line: Tips: It usually puts the shield up in front of staggered demons so you cannot glory kill them with ease, and also when you are holding the rocket launcher or sticky bombs. When the shield is right beside the carcass, detonate it with the plasma rifle; otherwise a pair of ballista shots or super shotgun blasts is enough. Up close, it spins around and lands two hits one after the other.

quoted: The carcass appears to summon its energy shield most often in front of demons in the stagger state, to prevent the Doom Slayer from being able to easily glory kill them, or when the player is equipped with the rocket launcher or sticky bombs.
If it summons its shield near itself, use the plasma rifle to detonate it, but otherwise a couple of ballista shots and/or super shotgun blasts should do the trick.
In close quarters, the carcass uses a spinning strike that hits twice in a row.

lines.line: Summary: A flying demon that spawns lost souls and attacks with them. They come as quick homing shots, as mines left on the ground, or in a barrage of three. Its health is about the same as a baron of Hell's.

quoted: The pain elemental retains its ability to spawn lost souls from its classic counterpart.
they will behave like fast homing projectiles that can be shot down before they hit the player.
the lost soul remains on the ground as a sort of proximity mine
generate a trio of lost souls and fire them off in a barrage.
they have health roughly on par with a baron of Hell

lines.line: Weak points: The rocket launcher's lock-on burst mod is a good answer, since it cannot dodge guided missiles: two volleys that connect kill it. As with other flying demons, the ballista does bonus damage to it.

quoted: The lock-on burst modification for the rocket launcher can effectively deal with pain elementals as they cannot avoid the path of the guided missiles and two unimpeded volleys are sufficient for a kill.
Like other flying monsters, it takes extra damage from the ballista.

lines.line: Looks like: A brown, round demon that flies, with one big red eye, a pair of long black horns, muscular arms with large claws, and a wide mouth with eight mandibles.

quoted: it is a circular, flying, brown demon with a single large red eye with an orange pupil, two long black horns, two muscular arms with prominent claws
a large mouth like that of the cacodemon with eight mandibles

lines.line: Tips: Shoot when it is busy or on the verge of attacking, because it air-dashes away if it sees a weapon aimed at it. It can also push its lost souls in front of your shots to use as shields. The mines hit harder than a direct attack and splash even on a near miss, so tight spaces are risky. Do not use the meat hook on it: you may latch onto one of its lost souls instead and be left somewhere dangerous.

quoted: Pain elementals will try to dodge attacks using an air-dash if they notice a weapon being pointed at them, so it is best to wait until it is either distracted or about to attack before shooting it
pain elementals may try to use their lost souls as living shields by forcing them to move into the path of incoming projectiles.
Be warned that these proximity mines deal more damage than a direct attack.
they will inflict splash damage even if a direct hit is avoided.
Using the meat hook on a pain elemental is not advised, as it may grapple onto a lost soul by accident and leave the player in a potentially fatal position.

lines.line: Summary: A cybernetic demon that fires missiles from an arm cannon. It is a major enemy that keeps coming back, often two at a time in later levels. One direct BFG hit is not enough to kill it.

quoted: The tyrant is a new monster in Doom Eternal, and the next iteration in the class of cyberdemons.
The tyrant mainly attacks by firing missiles from its arm cannon.
The tyrant is a recurring major enemy
Later levels frequently have them appear in pairs
As they have enough health to survive a single direct hit from the BFG-9000

lines.line: Weak points: It turns slowly, so circle behind it with a dash and hit it there. Its own dash is weak, so the meat hook and super shotgun work as long as you keep to its back. The Crucible kills it in one hit.

quoted: It is also slow to turn, so dashing around it is a good way to get a hit in.
they are vulnerable to the meat hook and the super shotgun so long as the player can stay behind them.
the most effective way to deal with them is to use the Crucible for an instant kill.

lines.line: Looks like: A two-legged demon with a cybernetic right leg, a weapon in place of its left arm, and an energy blade projecting from its right arm. Its ribs show, tubing fills its belly where intestines would be, and a mechanical-looking spine has vertebrae poking out of the flesh. Each side of its bulbous head carries two big horns, and its eyes are yellowish-white.

quoted: Both its right leg and left arm are cybernetics-enhanced, with minimal cybernetics along its right arm that can be used to project an energy blade.
a weapon which replaces its left arm
The tyrant is bipedal in nature

The tyrant's ribs are exposed, with its intestines replaced with tubing. Its spine appears to be mechanical, with vertebrae jutting out from the flesh. The tyrant has two large horns on each side of its head, and a bulbous cranium.
they are yellowish-white

lines.line: Tips: When it has no line of sight to you it fires a barrage of missiles, and glowing runes show where they will land. Once it spots you it pauses to aim, which is your chance to attack. An unmistakable triple beep warns of its laser cannon: either duck behind cover or dash right at the end to spoil its aim. Up close it swings the blade, or uses it for shockwaves.

quoted: If it cannot see the player, it will launch a missile barrage whose points of impact are marked by glowing runes.
When it sees the player, it takes a moment for it to take aim, so this window of time can be used to attack.
which is preceded by a very obvious triple beeping noise
the player should either take cover or dash at the last moment to ruin its aim.
In close quarters, it will try to slash the player with its blade or use it to release shockwaves.

lines.line: Summary: A heavy energy-beam weapon that fires in a straight line. It shoots slowly, but each shot hits harder than any other weapon's before mods, and no other weapon is as accurate. You get it after coming back from Doom Hunter Base.

quoted: it fires an energy beam in a straight line, with a slow fire rate compensated for by high attack power (the highest raw damage per shot of any weapon, excluding mods) and unmatched accuracy.
can be acquired after returning from the Doom Hunter Base.

lines.line: Uses: Its beam passes through demons it kills, so it handles a row of lined-up fodder. Each shot costs 25 cells, so save it for weak points that neither the heavy cannon nor the combat shotgun's sticky bombs can reach, for a hot-swap combo with another weapon, or for flying enemies like the pain elemental, which takes bonus damage from it.

quoted: Its shots will pierce through targets if it kills them, making it a good option for lined-up fodder demons.

As it consumes 25 cells per shot, it is best used either to destroy enemy weak points from distances too far for the heavy cannon or the combat shotgun's sticky bombs to hit, as part of a combo with a different weapon during hot swapping, or against flying enemies such as pain elementals to exploit the bonus damage it does against them.

lines.line: Tips: Arbalest mod: after a short charge it fires a dart that lodges in an enemy and blows up a moment later. It slows you while active and must be reloaded after every shot. Destroyer Blade mod: after charging, it shoots a broad, horizontal blast that pierces a cluster of enemies and costs 50 cells a shot. The recoil is strong enough to give you extra air time or push you across an arena, and with every ammo upgrade a full load is only ten shots, fewer than any other weapon.

quoted: Following a brief charging period, the ballista will fire a dart-like projectile that lodges into an enemy and explodes after a short time
it will reduce movement speed when active and needs to be reloaded in between shots.
After charging, the ballista fires a wide horizontal projectile. The projectile has a piercing effect, allowing it to clear out multiple clustered enemies in one shot.
It also uses up 50 cells per shot rather than the normal 25.
the ballista has a noticeable recoil which can be exploited for increased air time and propelling yourself across an arena.
With all ammo upgrades, it has the least shots on full ammo (ten) of any weapon in the game.
Arbalest
Destroyer Blade

lines.line: Summary: An all-round automatic rifle with two mods, Precision Bolt and Micro Missiles. You get it early on, once the second demon fight of the Hell on Earth level is over.

quoted: The heavy cannon is a multi-purpose automatic rifle
It is introduced in Hell on Earth, after the second demon encounter.
Precision Bolt
Micro Missiles

lines.line: Uses: It is dependable at middle to long range, and two body shots take down most fodder. On its own it struggles against tougher enemies, so use it from a distance to add damage alongside other weapons. The Precision Bolt scope makes shots more accurate and hits weak spots harder, enough to wreck an arachnotron's cannon or a revenant's rocket launchers. Micro Missiles do area damage without the self-damage you risk when firing the rocket launcher up close.

quoted: The heavy cannon is a reliable weapon at medium to long range, requiring no more than two body shots to kill most fodder monsters.
It is not as effective against stronger foes on its own, but can be used to supplement other weapons at long range.

The Precision Bolt greatly increases the weapon's accuracy and also deals extra damage to weak spots, enabling one to destroy, for example, the arachnotron's cannon or the revenant's rocket launchers.
micro missiles are best used to deal area-of-effect damage without risking the self-inflicted injury that would come with using the rocket launcher in close quarters.

lines.line: Tips: Precision Bolt is the best mod for Maykr drones, because killing one with a headshot makes it drop plenty of resources. The cannon is hitscan: the result of each shot is fixed the moment you fire. That suits quick fodder at long range, which the plasma rifle cannot hit. Micro Missiles home in slightly, launch as many as six missiles per salvo that explode on impact, and need a reload between salvos.

quoted: Using the precision bolt is also the best mod to use to kill Maykr drones as they drop a considerable amount of resources once killed with a headshot.
The heavy cannon is hitscan, meaning whether the shot fired hits or misses is decided when it is fired.
This can be of use against faster fodder demons at long ranges, especially ones that are too fast for the plasma rifle.
allowing the firing of up to six explosive missiles which detonate on impact. The missiles have minor homing abilities. Reloading is necessary in between salvos.

lines.line: Summary: A fast energy rifle that fires small, bright blue orbs of plasma. You first find it in Exultia, right after the trans-dimensional portal.

quoted: firing small bright blue compact orbs of plasma at a rapid rate.
It is first encountered in Exultia, after passing through the trans-dimensional portal.

lines.line: Uses: Energy shields, such as those of the shield soldier and the carcass, overload under plasma fire and explode, badly hurting whoever holds them and damaging nearby enemies. It also turns off a Doom hunter's body shield so it can be hurt, and wears down an armoured baron's armour. It cannot touch the magic shields of the arch-vile and the marauder.

quoted: Energy shields like the ones used by the shield soldier and carcass will overload and explode if hit by plasma rifle fire, severely damaging the shield's user and damaging other enemies nearby.
It can also disable the Doom hunter's body shield, exposing it to damage.
However, it cannot affect the magical shields used by the arch-vile and the marauder.
you can use it to chip at the armored baron's armor

lines.line: Tips: Enemies hit by several orbs in quick succession burst in an energy blast. That helps against crowds but can ruin a glory kill. The Microwave Beam mod is a short-range beam that locks onto an enemy, holds it still and keeps damaging it while the beam lasts. Nothing else you carry can kill a spirit, so keep it stocked when a demon is possessed. The Heat Blast mod fires a cone out in front of the weapon, and you charge it by firing the rifle normally.

quoted: enemies that are hit by several plasma orbs within a short time will explode in a burst of energy
While helpful against clustered enemies, this effect can be inconvenient if trying to go for a glory kill.
fires a concentrated, short-ranged beam of plasma energy that locks onto and immobilizes an enemy, inflicting constant damage as long as the beam is maintained.

The Microwave Beam mod for the plasma rifle is the only weapon in the player's arsenal that can eliminate a spirit, so it is important to keep it ready and stocked up with ammo when fighting a possessed demon.
firing in a cone ahead of the gun rather than in a circle centered on the player; as before, it must be charged up by using the plasma rifle's standard fire.

lines.line: Summary: A bomb fired from the Praetor suit's shoulder launcher that freezes its target solid. The frozen demon cannot move or fight back, and it breaks apart once it has taken enough damage. You choose it over the frag grenade with a toggle button.

quoted: Fired from the shoulder-mounted launcher of the Praetor suit, the ice bomb is a projectile that douses the target in "freezing gasses", causing a flash freeze.
The frozen enemy is then left immobile and helpless, and shatters after enough damage has been inflicted upon them.
It is selected as an ammunition type versus the frag grenade via a toggle key or button

lines.line: Uses: Freeze a target to hit it while it is stuck, to stop a dangerous enemy attacking, or to get away when you are surrounded. Whiplashes move fast, so the ice bomb is especially recommended against them. It also pins a pinky or spectre so you can go for its weak back end. You cannot glory kill a frozen enemy.

quoted: The ice bomb can be used to hold a target in place while you attack them, keep a dangerous enemy from fighting back, or to make a quick escape when surrounded.
It is strongly recommended when fighting whiplashes due to their fast movements, and it can be used to hold a pinky or spectre in place while you attack its vulnerable rear side.
Enemies frozen by an ice bomb cannot be glory killed

lines.line: Tips: How long a freeze lasts depends on the enemy: 4 seconds for most fodder; 2 for pinkies, revenants and cacodemons; 1.5 for mancubi and barons of Hell; 1 for tyrants. Once the bomb is upgraded, each of those lasts longer. It does nothing to demons that a spirit has possessed or a screecher has buffed. The cooldown is 45 seconds, or 35 with the faster cooldown suit upgrade.

quoted: || Fodder/Ambient, except for the riot soldier || 4 || 6
|| Pinky, spectre, revenant, whiplash, cacodemon, Hell knight, dread knight, and arachnotron || 2 || 4
|| Mancubus, pain elemental, arch-vile, and baron of Hell || 1.5 || 3
|| Doom hunter (except in Doom Hunter Base) and tyrant || 1 || 2
It also has no effect on demons that are possessed by a spirit or have been buffed by a screecher
The ice bomb has a cooldown of 45 seconds, or 35 seconds with the Faster Cooldown Praetor Suit upgrade.

lines.line: Summary: A quick blast of flame from the Praetor suit's shoulder launcher that lights enemies on fire. You find it at the Fortress of Doom, once Hell on Earth is finished, and it is ready to use whichever grenade type you have selected.

quoted: The flame belch fires a short burst of fire
found in the Fortress of Doom after completing the Hell on Earth level.
It is mounted on the equipment launcher attached to the Praetor suit's left shoulder
it is always available as a separate attack in addition to the currently selected grenade type.

lines.line: Uses: Enemies that are on fire take bonus damage and drop armour shards, and one that dies while burning drops more. It is your main way to get armour in a fight, and it works next to the chainsaw and glory kills as part of the combat loop. Sweep left and right as you fire to catch a group.

quoted: Enemies on fire will take additional damage and drop armor shards; killing an enemy while it is on fire will produce a larger shard drop.
The flame belch is the primary source of armor during battle, making it a vital part of Doom Eternal's "combat loop" along with glory kills and the chainsaw.
turning left and right while firing allows the belch to hit groups of opponents.

lines.line: Tips: The combat shotgun and super shotgun give extra armour when they kill a burning enemy. The cooldown is 25 seconds, or 12.5 with the Quickdraw Belch suit upgrade. Sentinel crystals buy three upgrades: that shorter cooldown, a longer burn on heavy and super heavy demons, and armour that drops out faster.

quoted: The combat shotgun and super shotgun will produce more armor when killing a burning enemy.
The flame belch has a cooldown of 25 seconds, or 12.5 seconds with the Quickdraw Belch Praetor Suit upgrade.
By using Sentinel crystals, the player can unlock three upgrades for the flame belch that boost its capabilities
Heavy and Super Heavy demons stay on fire longer.
Demons drop armor at a faster rate.
Quickdraw Belch

lines.line: Summary: A powerful melee strike that you charge up by getting glory kills. Its shockwave also damages enemies around the one you hit. You first pick it up as a glowing artifact in Exultia.

quoted: a devastating melee attack which can be unleashed after charging it with glory kills.
a melee attack that releases a shockwave when hitting a monster, damaging nearby foes in addition to the primary target.
The blood punch is first acquired in the form of a glowing artifact found in Exultia.

lines.line: Uses: Pinkies and spectres die instantly, or at least take severe damage, and tougher monsters take heavy damage. It breaks enemy shields, including the arch-vile's magical one. It is very likely to damage a weak point, up to wrecking a cyber-mancubus's armour entirely.

quoted: It can instantly kill (or at least severely damage) pinkies and spectres, and deal heavy damage to stronger monsters as well.
it can break through enemy shields, even magic ones like that of the arch-vile.
It has a very high chance of weak point damage, including complete destruction of the cyber-mancubus's armor.

lines.line: Tips: It uses no ammo, but it needs charging first: two glory kills make one charge, and you can hold only one at a time. It gets three automatic upgrades later in the game: a stronger shockwave, an instant charge from one glory kill on a heavy demon, and room for a second charge. Against a big group of fodder, freeze them, burn them with the flame belch, then blood punch one to take your health and armour to full.

quoted: Although it does not require ammo, it must be charged before use by performing glory kills. Two glory kills will provide a single charge, and only one charge can be stored at a time.
Doom Hunter Base: "The Blood Punch shockwave is now more powerful."
While it is not upgraded directly, the blood punch receives three automatic upgrades upon clearing the following missions:
Sentinel Prime: "Glory kills on Heavy Demons will now instantly charge a Blood Punch."
there is no difference; a glory kill on a Super Heavy demon will likewise instantly charge a single blood punch.
Urdak: "Two Blood Punch attacks can now be charged."
If you encounter a large number of fodder enemies in a group, freezing them, flame belching them, and then blood punching one of them is a good way to max out your health and armor
